value_rules.formula: Conjugated bilirubin (umol/L) cannot exceed total bilirubin (umol/L)
Unconjugated bilirubin (umol/L) = total bilirubin (umol/L) - conjugated bilirubin (umol/L)
Ionised calcium (mmol/L) cannot exceed total calcium (mmol/L)
Free light chain ratio = free kappa (mg/L) / free lambda (mg/L)
HDL cholesterol (mmol/L) cannot exceed total cholesterol (mmol/L)
MCV (fL) = 1000 x haematocrit (L/L) / red cell count (x10^12/L)
Non-HDL cholesterol (mmol/L) = total cholesterol (mmol/L) - HDL cholesterol (mmol/L)
Reticulocytes (%) = 0.1 x reticulocytes (x10^9/L) / red cell count (x10^12/L)
Transferrin saturation (%) = serum iron (umol/L) / TIBC (umol/L) x 100
White cell count (x10^9/L) = neutrophils + lymphocytes + monocytes + eosinophils + basophils (each x10^9/L), within 5%
